description: Project adapter for a Next.js 16 modular web monolith with framework-free domain/application modules and persistence adapters.
architecture_form: modular monolith with ports and adapters
data_store: Browser IndexedDB for Sprint 1; server/Supabase adapters only when approved
target_platform: Modern web browser plus Node.js server runtime

Node 22 as the project target runtime

license: Adapter metadata is project-internal. Next.js/React/ESLint are MIT; Playwright/TypeScript/fake-indexeddb use their respective upstream open-source licenses. Project source-code license remains undecided.
provenance: Generated from current official package/runtime sources plus Jira MCL architecture drivers on 2026-08-11.
